# Warlock AI Ollama

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-ollama`

> Ollama adapter for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [ai-ollama](@warlock.js/ai-ollama/skills/SKILL.md): Local Ollama models for Warlock AI: `OllamaSDK`, `OllamaCallOptions`, `OllamaModelConfig` and `OllamaEmbedderConfig`. Use for "run a local LLM", "connect Ollama", pull model tags, stream chat, use tools, configure thinking or generate embeddings through `model()` and `embedder()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents and RAG; @warlock.js/ai-openai for hosted OpenAI-compatible servers.
